projects.title: Cold Shelter
projects.description:
Cold Shelter is a first-person horror game that takes place in a snow-covered forest. Your car breaks down during a snowstorm, leaving you stranded in the middle of nowhere. Find shelter, explore your surroundings, find help and make your way out of there. Escaping the cold is only the beginning. This game features a linear story, environmental interactions, immersive graphics,
creepy atmosphere and AI behaviors. The game was developed in Unity.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented gameplay systems for interactions, objectives, dialogue, puzzles, and jumpscares, supported by a reusable trigger-based event system
- Implemented enemy AI with roaming behaviour, chase encounters, and jumpscare events
- Implemented UI navigation and settings menus for graphics, audio, and general gameplay options
- Designed and built the entire game map
- Developed the game’s story
- Edited and integrated audio to support atmosphere and gameplay events
- Integrated third-party assets and adapted them to the game’s requirements

projects.title: Bowling Madness
projects.description: Bowling Madness is a 3D isometric endless platformer where you guide a bowling ball through a generated obstacle course. Move your mouse to steer and control the force applied to the ball—the farther the cursor, the greater the force. Navigate hazards, use launchers and power-ups, and knock down pins at the end of each section to gain extra time. See how far you can get before the timer runs out.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented a mouse-driven physics controller, timer, checkpoints, respawning, power-ups, and interactive obstacles with effects such as stunning, knockback, and launching
- Used object pooling to recycle course sections, enabling endless generation
- Designed all the course sections
- Created all the assets used in this prototype using Blender

projects.title: Shut The Box
projects.description: A prototype inspired by the board game Shut the Box, featuring numbered tiles from 1 to 12. Roll the dice and close any combination of tiles that adds up to the total, aiming to close them all. A mouse-driven dice throw lets you drag to set the direction and release to roll, with longer drags adding more spin and power.
projects.contributions: - Implemented mouse-driven dice throwing, dice result detection, tile-selection validation, and scoring logic.

projects.title: Isle of the Forsaken
projects.description: Isle of the Forsaken is a game that follows the story of a man stranded on a forsaken island trying to find his way back home.
projects.contributions:
- Implemented environmental interactions, jumpscares, objectives, dialogues, AI behaviours, footsteps system and AI voiceovers
- Designed the level layout and established its atmosphere through lighting and environmental details.
